content: This is my first post! Here I can write any story I want. Not sure about the maximum length yet, but I'll find out later.

So I went out for a quick walk and somehow ended up helping a lost duck cross the road. 🦆 No idea where it came from, but it followed me home, sat on my doorstep for 10 minutes, then waddled away like nothing happened. Best Friday ever.
Spent the afternoon digging through a box of records at the market. Came home with a jazz album I had never heard of and it is already on repeat.
Sunday plans: coffee, a new record, and absolutely no rushing anywhere.
Morning run done before the city woke up. The canals were so quiet today.
The tiny robot can finally follow a line without driving straight into the table leg. Small victories.
Looking for a good name for a robot the size of a coffee mug. Suggestions welcome.
Update: the robot is called Pico, and it has already knocked over exactly one houseplant.
Game night was meant to be a quick one. Three hours later, nobody had moved from the table and we were negotiating a rematch.
Any board game recommendations for a group that enjoys clever strategy but still wants to finish before midnight?
Took my film camera out in Leiden this afternoon. The light on the old brick streets was worth carrying it around all day.
Made pancakes for breakfast and accidentally made enough for the entire building. Neighbours are now very well fed.
Testing a new pancake topping tomorrow. Thinking apple and cinnamon. What would you add?
